# Marked Digital

> The growth partner for e-commerce brands going global. International expansion, paid media, tech stacks, web builds and SEO/AEO, run as one compounding system accountable to revenue.

Marked Digital is a Toronto-based growth agency for e-commerce brands. Founded and led by Mark Youash (Managing Director, 13 years in e-commerce), it exists because growth kept getting sold in pieces: strategy in one shop, ads in another, the site in a third. Marked runs all of it as a single system.

## What we do

- International Ecommerce Expansion: market prioritization, localized storefronts and checkout, cross-border logistics and tax, local paid + organic launch. 47 markets launched.
- Digital Advertising & Paid Media: full-funnel paid across Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon and retail media, engineered around incrementality. +312% average ROAS lift.
- Tech Stack Implementation: stack audits, platform selection, integration and data architecture, AI pipeline development, implementation and migration.
- Website Development: headless/composable commerce builds, Core Web Vitals, CRO, multi-regional + localization. +34% average conversion lift.
- SEO, AEO & Content: rankings where people still Google, presence inside ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews where they increasingly don't. Entity and schema optimization, programmatic content, digital PR. 6.4x organic sessions.

## Proof

- Ontario Education Online: an Ontario online school that had never run a digital marketing program. In nine months Marked built the whole system, from first search to enrolment: search ads for every course, AI discovery that gets the school cited by ChatGPT and other assistants, a website rebuilt to convert, and tracking that shows which channels produce enrolments. +1,183% revenue year over year, January to September 2026. https://marked-digital.com/work/ontario-education-online
- Roadpost: record $20.9M FY24 e-commerce revenue, up 118% year over year, $8M on Amazon USA. https://marked-digital.com/work/roadpost
- Casa Nina Flamingo: a Costa Rica villa that sleeps 14, previously booked only through Airbnb. In 45 days Marked built it a premium site from scratch on its own domain, made to be discovered by search engines and AI crawlers and to encourage direct bookings. Advertising is the next phase. https://marked-digital.com/work/casa-nina-flamingo
